set.body:
Defect: D7's second half. probe.verifyInput (media/probe.scala:273) compares a Checksum the CALLER hands over -- verification of a number, not of bytes. FixtureManifest.verify(bytes) exists (media/manifest.scala:96-133) and is never on a main path.

Do: Migrate the media probe onto VerifiedArtifact.

Mutants (SD1 — each must die, recorded by name): hand verifyInput a checksum that does not match the bytes -> must refuse.

Exit: D7 is closed on both halves. Without this bead D7 stays open in the media module however complete the corpus side is.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-17-annotation-intake-contract.md S4 'minimum subset'
set.title: intake P5: media probe must verify bytes, not a caller-supplied checksum
